items.title: A property of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes stable under thickenings, affine limits and splittings descends to Spec of a field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the formal device by which the chapter reduces properties of schemes to properties over fields (statement lines 17045-17063). The proof's content is the minimality argument: one takes a minimal closed subscheme T' with P, deduces it is reduced from the thickening invariance (proof lines 17067-17070), and then applies the third assumption to the affine open neighbourhoods V of an irreducible component's generic point and the second assumption to their limit, obtaining P(Spec(K)) (proof lines 17074-17076). H2: the argument is a short chain of standard reductions, not a long construction.
